plugin.note: Use Feral Vampyres for the simplest assignment, Slepe Vyrewatch after A Taste of Hope, or upgrade to Darkmeyer Vyrewatch Sentinels after Sins of the Father.

requirements: Priest in Peril and 35 combat to receive Vampyre tasks.
Actual Vampyre Slayer unlock for Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal assignments.
More at stake unlock for 200-250 extended tasks.
A Taste of Hope for practical Vyrewatch access and Ivandis flail use.
Sins of the Father for the profitable Vyrewatch Sentinel path.
mechanics: Feral Vampyres can be damaged with any weapon and always drop vampyre dust.
Vampyre Juveniles can be damaged with any weapon but retreat at low health unless held and handled with Guthix balance.
Vampyre Juvinates require silver weaponry or Efaritay's aid to damage and can also require Guthix balance handling.
Vyrewatch require an Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, or Hallowed flail; Efaritay's aid gives accuracy but does not make normal weapons damage them.
Slepe Vyrewatch are aggressive, do not use the blood tithe approach, and attack faster than the flying variants.
Vyrewatch Sentinels are the best higher-tier target due to blood shard drops and nearby Darkmeyer banking and prayer restoration.

methods.label: Requirements and unlocks
methods.summary: Start with Mazchna or Vannaka assignments after Priest in Peril and 35 combat, then unlock wider master access with Actual Vampyre Slayer.
steps: Confirm Priest in Peril and 35 combat before seeking the task.
Use Mazchna or Vannaka before purchasing Actual Vampyre Slayer.
Purchase Actual Vampyre Slayer for 80 Slayer points to unlock Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal assignments.
Purchase More at stake for 100 Slayer points when longer 200-250 kill tasks are desired.
notes: The task has no Slayer level requirement on the task page, though individual Vyrewatch paths have quest and weapon restrictions.

methods.label: Feral Vampyre quick task
methods.summary: Kill Feral Vampyres with ordinary melee gear for the simplest task path and guaranteed vampyre dust.
steps: Use Haunted Woods, Burgh de Rott, God Wars Dungeon, or Wilderness God Wars Dungeon based on access and risk preference.
Bring ordinary melee gear because Feral Vampyres can be damaged with any weapon.
Use safespots or cannon support where the location allows it.
Wear a Zamorak item in God Wars Dungeon locations if avoiding faction aggression.
Collect vampyre dust if useful for prayer or Hallowed Sepulchre supplies.
risks: Haunted Woods leeches can drain stats and do not appear on the minimap.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon carries player-killing risk.
God Wars Dungeon Feral Vampyre spawns are spread out and not a convenient default.

methods.label: Juvenile and Juvinate handling
methods.summary: Use Retainer special attack and Guthix balance mechanics when attempting Juvenile or Juvinate kills that would otherwise mist away.
recommendedFor: players intentionally killing lower vampyre tiers
quest-progression areas with Juveniles or Juvinates
requiredOrKeyItems: Rod of ivandis, Ivandis flail, or Blisterwood flail
Silver weaponry or Efaritay's aid for Juvinates
steps: Lower the Juvenile or Juvinate to low health.
Use the Retainer special attack from Rod of ivandis, Ivandis flail, or Blisterwood flail to hold it.
Use Guthix balance to resolve the held vampyre.
If the result creates a Feral Vampyre, kill the Feral Vampyre for task progress.
risks: Juveniles and many Juvinates are not recommended for normal task progress.
Some outcomes return the vampyre to human form instead of giving task progress.

methods.label: Slepe Vyrewatch prayer
methods.summary: After A Taste of Hope, kill the aggressive Slepe Vyrewatch with flail weapons and Protect from Melee.
recommendedFor: players with A Taste of Hope completed
requiredOrKeyItems: Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, or Hallowed flail
prayers: Offensive melee prayers if supplies allow
steps: Teleport to Ver Sinhaza with Drakan's medallion.
Run north to Slepe and use the nearby Altar of Zamorak route for prayer restoration.
Wear prayer-focused melee gear and use Protect from Melee.
Keep inventory space free for vampyre dust and runite bar drops.
notes: The Slepe group north of Crombwick Manor is aggressive unless the player is wearing a full Vyre noble disguise.

methods.label: Sentinel upgrade path
methods.summary: After Sins of the Father, switch to Vyrewatch Sentinels in Darkmeyer for the stronger profit-focused task path.
recommendedFor: players with Sins of the Father completed
requiredOrKeyItems: Vyre noble clothing for bank access
steps: Use the dedicated Vyrewatch Sentinel strategy for detailed Darkmeyer routing.
Fight near the west Arboretum bank and altar area.
Bring Vyre noble clothing if using Darkmeyer bank tellers.
Use the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby bank chest when avoiding disguise swaps.
notes: Vyrewatch Sentinels are close to a bank and altar and can drop blood shards.

styleOptions.label: Feral Vampyre melee
styleOptions.summary: Use ordinary melee gear because Feral Vampyres can be damaged with any weapon.

styleOptions.label: Flail Vyrewatch prayer
styleOptions.summary: Use Ivandis or Blisterwood flail with Protect from Melee for Vyrewatch and Sentinel paths.
